grammar.en: I have been working part-time at a supermarket near the station since April last year. At first the cash register work was difficult, and I often made mistakes. reading.en: I came to Japan three months ago. Right after I arrived, I had to go to the city hall to register my address. But I didn't understand much Japanese yet, so I was very worried. listening.question: {男|おとこ}の{人|ひと}は{何|なん}の{手続|てつづ}きをしに{来|き}ましたか。
options: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{手続|てつづ}き
{子|こ}どもが{生|う}まれた{手続|てつづ}き
{結婚|けっこん}の{手続|てつづ}き
listening.en: At the city hall, a man and a staff member are talking. What procedure did the man come for? F: Hello. How can I help you today? M: My child was born, so I came to do the paperwork for that. F: Congratulations. Then please fill in this form. M: Oh, and could I also get the paper about how to put out rubbish? I only moved here last month. F: Yes, here you are.
listening.why: He came to register his newborn child; the rubbish paper is just extra.

listening.setup: {男|おとこ}の{人|ひと}と{女|おんな}の{人|ひと}が{話|はな}しています。{男|おとこ}の{人|ひと}はどうしてかばんを{買|か}いませんでしたか。

lines.jp: あれ、{新|あたら}しいかばん、{買|か}わなかったの？
うん。デザインはよかったし、{値段|ねだん}もセールで{安|やす}くなってたんだけど。
{大|おお}きさは？
{大|おお}きさもちょうどよかった。でも、{持|も}ってみたら{重|おも}くて。{毎日|まいにち}{使|つか}うから、{軽|かる}いのがいいんだ。

listening.question: {男|おとこ}の{人|ひと}はどうしてかばんを{買|か}いませんでしたか。
options: デザインがよくなかったから
listening.en: A man and a woman are talking. Why didn't the man buy the bag? F: Oh, you didn't buy the new bag? M: No. The design was good, and the price was lower because of the sale, but... F: What about the size? M: The size was just right too. But when I held it, it was heavy. I use it every day, so I want a light one.
listening.why: The bag was too heavy.

listening.setup: {店|みせ}で{買|か}ったセーターを、{別|べつ}の{色|いろ}にしてほしいです。{店員|てんいん}に{何|なん}と{言|い}いますか。
listening.question: {何|なん}と{言|い}いますか。
options: この{色|いろ}、{似合|にあ}いますか。
これ、{別|べつ}の{色|いろ}と{取|と}り{替|か}えてもらえますか。
{別|べつ}の{色|いろ}を{買|か}ってあげましょうか。
listening.en: You want to change a sweater you bought for a different colour. What do you say to the clerk? 1 Does this colour suit me? 2 Could you exchange this for a different colour? 3 Shall I buy you a different colour?
listening.why: You are asking the clerk to exchange it.

listening.setup: アルバイトに{遅|おく}れそうです。{店長|てんちょう}に{電話|でんわ}で{何|なん}と{言|い}いますか。
listening.question: {何|なん}と{言|い}いますか。
options: {遅|おく}れてもかまいませんよ。
{早|はや}く{来|き}てくださいね。
すみません、{十分|じゅっぷん}ぐらい{遅|おく}れそうです。
listening.en: You are going to be late for your part-time job. What do you say to the manager on the phone? 1 It's fine if you're late. 2 Please come early. 3 I'm sorry, I think I'll be about ten minutes late.
listening.why: You apologise and say you will be late.

listening.setup: {市役所|しやくしょ}で、{書類|しょるい}の{書|か}き{方|かた}がわかりません。{係|かかり}の{人|ひと}に{何|なん}と{言|い}いますか。
listening.question: {何|なん}と{言|い}いますか。
options: すみません、ここの{書|か}き{方|かた}を{教|おし}えていただけませんか。
ここに{書|か}いておきましょうか。
{書|か}き{方|かた}を{教|おし}えてあげます。
listening.en: At the city hall, you don't know how to fill in a form. What do you say to the staff member? 1 Excuse me, could you tell me how to fill in this part? 2 Shall I write it here for you? 3 I'll teach you how to write it.
listening.why: You are politely asking to be taught.

listening.setup: {店|みせ}で、{気|き}に{入|い}ったセーターを{着|き}てみたいです。{店員|てんいん}に{何|なん}と{言|い}いますか。
listening.question: {何|なん}と{言|い}いますか。
options: これ、{着|き}てもらえませんか。
これ、{着|き}てみてもいいですか。
listening.en: At a shop, you want to try on a sweater you like. What do you say to the clerk? 1 Could you wear this? 2 Why don't you try it on? 3 May I try this on?
listening.why: You are asking permission to try it on.

listening.setup: {買|か}い{物|もの}のあと、{友|とも}だちが{重|おも}い{袋|ふくろ}を{二|ふた}つ{持|も}っています。{友|とも}だちに{何|なん}と{言|い}いますか。
listening.question: {何|なん}と{言|い}いますか。
options: {一|ひと}つ{持|も}ってくれませんか。
{一|ひと}つ{持|も}ちましょうか。
{一|ひと}つ{持|も}ってもいいですよ。
listening.en: After shopping, your friend is carrying two heavy bags. What do you say? 1 Could you carry one for me? 2 Shall I carry one? 3 You may carry one.
listening.why: You are offering to help carry one.

lines.jp: このかばん、もう{少|すこ}し{安|やす}くなりませんか。

options: すみません、セールの{品物|しなもの}なので、これ{以上|いじょう}は…。
はい、{少|すこ}し{高|たか}くなりました。
じゃあ、{安|やす}くしてください。
listening.en: M: Can't you make this bag a little cheaper? 1 Sorry, it's a sale item, so we can't go lower... 2 Yes, it got a little more expensive. 3 Then please make it cheaper.
listening.why: The clerk answers the customer's request for a lower price.

lines.jp: {山田|やまだ}くん、{明日|あした}、{一時間|いちじかん}{早|はや}く{来|こ}られる？

options: はい、{来|き}てもいいですよ。
はい、{一時間|いちじかん}{早|はや}く{来|き}ました。
はい、{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}です。
listening.en: F: Yamada-kun, can you come an hour early tomorrow? 1 Yes, you may come. 2 Yes, I came an hour early. 3 Yes, that's fine.
listening.why: He says he can come.

lines.jp: こちらにお{名前|なまえ}をお{書|か}きください。

options: はい、どうぞお{書|か}きください。
いいえ、{書|か}いてもらいました。
listening.en: M: Please write your name here. 1 Yes, please write it. 2 OK, here, right? 3 No, I had someone write it.
listening.why: You check the place before writing.

lines.jp: いらっしゃいませ。{何|なに}かお{探|さが}しですか。

options: はい、どうぞ{探|さが}してください。
いいえ、{探|さが}しませんでした。
いえ、{見|み}ているだけです。
listening.en: F: Welcome. Are you looking for something? 1 Yes, please look for it. 2 No, I didn't look for it. 3 No, I'm just looking.
listening.why: 'Just looking' is the natural reply to a shop clerk.

lines.jp: このシャツ、レシートがなくても{返品|へんぴん}できますか。

options: {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません、レシートが{必要|ひつよう}なんです。
はい、レシートをお{返|かえ}しします。
いいえ、{返品|へんぴん}しませんでした。
listening.en: M: Can I return this shirt without a receipt? 1 I'm sorry, a receipt is necessary. 2 Yes, I'll give you back the receipt. 3 No, I didn't return it.
listening.why: The clerk explains that a receipt is needed.

lines.jp: アルバイト、もう{慣|な}れた？

options: うん、{慣|な}れたほうがいいよ。
うん、だいぶ{慣|な}れてきたよ。
listening.en: F: Have you got used to your part-time job yet? 1 Yeah, you'd better get used to it. 2 Yeah, I've got quite used to it. 3 Yeah, I made someone get used to it.
listening.why: It answers about yourself getting used to the job.

lines.jp: すみません、{窓口|まどぐち}は{何時|なんじ}まで{開|あ}いていますか。

listening.en: M: Excuse me, until what time is the counter open? 1 It opens from nine. 2 I opened it at five. 3 Until five.
listening.why: The question asks 'until when', so the answer gives the closing time.

lines.jp: お{会計|かいけい}は{三千円|さんぜんえん}になります。

options: いいえ、{三千円|さんぜんえん}になりません。
はい、{一万円|いちまんえん}でお{願|ねが}いします。
じゃあ、{三千円|さんぜんえん}あげます。
listening.en: F: That will be 3,000 yen. 1 No, it won't become 3,000 yen. 2 OK, here's 10,000 yen. 3 Then I'll give you 3,000 yen.
listening.why: You pay with a 10,000 yen note.
